title: Sourdough starter
text: Feeding a sourdough starter every twelve hours with equal parts flour and water keeps the wild yeast active. Discard half before each feeding, and keep the jar somewhere warm so it doubles within six hours.

title: Tomato pasta
text: Saute garlic in olive oil, add crushed tomatoes and basil, simmer for twenty minutes, then toss with spaghetti and parmesan for a quick weeknight dinner.

title: Marathon training
text: Long runs on Sunday build endurance for the marathon. Increase weekly mileage by no more than ten percent, add a recovery day after hard sessions, and taper during the final two weeks.

title: Strength training
text: Squats, deadlifts and bench press form the core of a beginner lifting program. Add small weight increments each week and rest at least a day between sessions for the same muscle group.

title: Index funds
text: Low-cost index funds spread money across hundreds of companies. Regular monthly contributions and reinvested dividends matter more over decades than trying to time the market.

title: Mortgages
text: A fixed-rate mortgage keeps your monthly payment constant for the whole term, while an adjustable rate can start lower but rise when the central bank raises interest rates.

title: Python decorators
text: A Python decorator is a function that wraps another function to add behaviour such as logging or caching, applied with the at-sign syntax above the definition.

title: Database indexes
text: A database index speeds up lookups by keeping a sorted structure of column values, at the cost of slower writes and extra disk space. Index the columns used in WHERE and JOIN clauses.

title: Git rebase
text: Rebasing replays your commits on top of another branch to keep history linear. Never rebase commits that teammates have already pulled, because it rewrites shared history.

title: Docker layers
text: Each instruction in a Dockerfile creates an image layer. Order instructions from least to most frequently changing so the build cache is reused and rebuilds stay fast.

title: Tokyo trip
text: Three days in Tokyo: morning at the Tsukiji outer market, afternoon in Shibuya and Harajuku, and an evening ride up Tokyo Skytree. Buy a Suica card for the trains.

title: Patagonia hiking
text: The W Trek in Torres del Paine takes four to five days. Book campsites months ahead, pack layers for sudden wind and rain, and start the hike to the towers before sunrise.

title: Rose care
text: Prune roses in late winter, cutting above an outward-facing bud. Water deeply once a week rather than sprinkling daily, and mulch to keep the roots cool.

title: Composting
text: A good compost heap balances green kitchen scraps with brown dry leaves, stays damp like a wrung sponge, and is turned every few weeks so it heats up and breaks down.

title: Sleep hygiene
text: Going to bed at the same time each night, keeping the bedroom cool and dark, and avoiding screens and caffeine in the evening all help you fall asleep faster.

title: Meditation
text: Sit comfortably, close your eyes, and follow the breath. When the mind wanders, gently return attention to breathing. Ten minutes a day lowers stress over time.

title: Cat health
text: Adult cats need annual vaccinations and dental checks. Sudden weight loss, hiding, or refusing food for more than a day are reasons to visit the vet.

title: Puppy training
text: Teach a puppy to sit by holding a treat above its nose and rewarding the instant it lowers its hindquarters. Short, positive sessions work better than long drills.

title: Climate change
text: Rising atmospheric carbon dioxide traps heat, melting glaciers and raising sea levels. Cutting emissions from power plants and transport is the fastest lever available.

title: Solar panels
text: A rooftop solar array converts sunlight directly into electricity. South-facing roofs with little shade produce the most, and a home battery stores surplus for the evening.

title: Job interviews
text: Prepare three stories that show problem solving and teamwork, research the company, and ask thoughtful questions at the end. Follow up with a thank-you note the same day.

title: Salary negotiation
text: When you receive an offer, thank them, ask for time, and counter with a researched number. Consider equity, bonus, vacation and flexibility, not only base pay.

title: Photography
text: Shoot in the golden hour just after sunrise or before sunset for warm, soft light. Use a wide aperture for blurred backgrounds and keep ISO low to avoid grain.

title: Guitar practice
text: Practise chord changes slowly with a metronome, starting at sixty beats per minute, and only speed up once every change is clean. Fifteen focused minutes beat an hour of noodling.

title: Chess openings
text: Control the centre with pawns, develop knights before bishops, castle early for king safety, and avoid moving the same piece twice in the opening.

title: Coffee brewing
text: For pour-over coffee use water just off the boil, a medium-fine grind, and a ratio of about sixteen parts water to one part coffee. Bloom the grounds for thirty seconds first.

title: Tax filing
text: Gather income statements, deductible receipts and last year's return before filing. Contributions to retirement accounts and charitable donations can reduce taxable income.

title: Kubernetes
text: A Kubernetes deployment keeps a set number of pod replicas running, replacing any that crash, and rolls out new container images gradually to avoid downtime.

title: Overfitting
text: Overfitting happens when a model memorises training examples and fails on new data. Hold out a validation set, use regularisation, and stop training when validation error rises.

title: Language learning
text: Spaced repetition flashcards, daily listening, and speaking with native partners build vocabulary faster than memorising grammar tables alone.
